$comment: The bundled Python runtime and the AI packages, in one place. CI reads this to build the shipped runtime; the app reads it again at run time so an in-app install uses exactly the same versions as a bundled one.
$comment_indexes: torch is resolved from one of these rather than PyPI. The wheels there carry a local version tag (2.9.1+cu130), which sorts above the plain PyPI 2.9.1, so the CUDA build wins without pinning a version that would rot. torchvision comes along the same way.
